heading: Questions? We can read your mind

items.q: What is BBA in Business Psychology?
a: The BBA in Business Psychology at ATLAS ISME equips students with a blend of psychological insight, business acumen and entrepreneurial thinking. The curriculum spans cognitive, business and positive psychology alongside core business competencies, preparing students to understand human behaviour in organisational, consumer and leadership contexts.

items.q: What is the scope of business psychology?
a: The scope is wide and growing. Business Psychology graduates can work across HR, consulting, consumer research, UX, marketing organisational development and leadership coaching. As companies increasingly invest in understanding human behaviour to drive performance and culture, professionals with this dual skill set are in high demand.

Yes. With organisations placing greater emphasis on employee wellbeing, consumer behaviour and people analytics, business psychologists are sought across corporates, start-ups, consultancies and research firms. The combination of psychology and business skills is increasingly rare and valued.

items.q: What's the highest-paid job in psychology?
a: While the website does not specify salary figures, high-paying psychology-adjacent roles in the business world include Organisational Psychologist, People Analytics Lead, Consumer Insights Strategist and UX Researcher, all roles that the ATLAS ISME Business Psychology curriculum prepares students for.

items.q: What careers can I pursue with a BBA in Business Psychology?
a: Graduates are well-prepared for a wide range of careers, including HR & People Analytics, Consumer Behaviour Research organisational Development, Leadership Coaching, Marketing & Brand Strategy, UX Research, Talent Management and Entrepreneurship. The final year includes advanced subjects like Organisational Development, Psychology of Innovation and People Analytics, specifically oriented toward career-readiness.

items.q: Is Business Psychology the same as a Psychology degree?
a: No. A traditional Psychology degree is more clinically and academically oriented. Business Psychology at ATLAS ISME combines psychological theory with business, management and entrepreneurship, making it a career-focused, industry-integrated degree aimed at the corporate and organisational world rather than clinical practice.

items.q: Can Commerce or Science students pursue BBA Business Psychology?
a: Yes. The eligibility requires a minimum of 50% in Class XII in any stream, Commerce, Science or Arts are all accepted. No specific subject background is required, making it accessible to students from all backgrounds who are curious about human behaviour and business.

items.q: What subjects are included in BBA Business Psychology?
a: The curriculum covers Cognitive Psychology, Business Psychology, Positive Psychology, Principles of Management, Marketing Management, Consumer Behaviour, Communication Psychology organisational Behaviour, Behavioural Psychology, Psychology of Innovation, Entrepreneurial Psychology, People Analytics organisational Development, Finance for Enterprise and a Capstone Research Thesis, alongside mandatory internships each semester.
